name: myq
description: Read and move your own myQ garage doors, through the open-source myq CLI.
long_description: Ask Claude whether a garage door is open, and have it open or close one. It operates the myQ app on your Android phone over adb, so this computer needs adb and the phone must be connected, unlocked and signed in to myQ. Unofficial; not affiliated with Chamberlain Group or myQ.

tools.name: myq_doors
tools.description: Your garage doors and whether each is open or closed.

tools.name: myq_app_open
tools.description: Bring the myQ app to your phone's screen, so its doors can be read.

tools.name: myq_door_open
tools.description: Open a garage door, and report what a read-back shows.

tools.name: myq_door_close
tools.description: Close a garage door, and report what a read-back shows.
